facts.text: Sir Alfred, the undead knight, was left incapacitated but not destroyed in Sir Brandon's tomb and may recover and attack the party if they return.

Sir Alfred may recover and kill the Free Goblin Society members now settling the upper Barrow Mound (church, antechamber and statue room), unless the wall they agreed to build across the stairs holds him back.
Why does Sir Alfred, a huge undead knight with a greatsword whom Brother Dirk regards as holy, roam the Barrow Mound?
